🙏 **Jai Mata Di!** Your 3-day Vaishno Devi trip is ready for 2 pilgrims from Delhi.

### 📋 Trip Overview
• **Destination:** Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine & Katra Base Town, Jammu & Kashmir
• **Starting Location:** Delhi
• **Duration:** 3 Days / 2 Nights
• **Travellers:** 2 Pilgrims (1 room allocated at 2 adults/room)
• **Darshan Category:** Normal Darshan · 23 November
• **Primary Transit:** Delhi → Katra by Bus
• **Key Assumptions:** Dedicated full day for the 13 km sacred trek; 1 rooms for 2 nights; balanced meal allowance of ₹350/person/day.

### 📅 Day-Wise Itinerary

#### Day 1: Arrival, Base Orientation & Yatra Registration
*Base: Katra Base Town | Exertion: Light*
• 10:00 AM – 01:30 PM: Travel by Bus via FlixBus (bus_flixbus_delhi_katra_express) departing at 18:25 from Delhi to Katra
• 01:30 PM – 03:00 PM: Direct arrival at Katra Bus Stand and transfer to hotel and check-in at Niharika Complex (Yatri Niwas, Shakti Bhawan & Ashirwad) (Dharamshala)
• 03:30 PM – 05:00 PM: Obtain mandatory Yatra RFID Registration Card at Katra Yatra Registration Counter
• 05:30 PM – 07:30 PM: Evening Katra market stroll (dry fruits, prasad) & orientation
• 08:00 PM – Onward: Early dinner and overnight rest in Katra to prepare for tomorrow's holy trek
• 🍽️ **Meals:** Welcome refreshments upon arrival; early traditional Dogra vegetarian dinner in Katra.
• 🏨 **Stay:** Overnight at Niharika Complex (Yatri Niwas, Shakti Bhawan & Ashirwad) (Dharamshala)

#### Day 2: Dedicated Holy Yatra & Darshan Trek
*Base: Katra ➔ Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Bhawan | Exertion: High*
• 05:30 AM – 06:30 AM: Early morning trek departure from Katra base via Ban Ganga / Tarakote Marg (13 km ascent)
• 08:00 AM – 09:30 AM: En route darshan pause at Charan Paduka & Ardhkuwari Cave (Garbh Joon)
• 11:00 AM – 01:30 PM: Sacred Darshan of Maa Vaishno Devi Ji at Holy Bhawan (Normal Darshan at 18:00)
• 02:00 PM – 03:30 PM: Ascent to Bhairavnath Temple via ropeway / uphill trek (completes the pilgrimage)
• 04:30 PM – 08:30 PM: Scenic descent back to Katra base town and overnight muscle recovery
• 🍽️ **Meals:** Early energizing breakfast; pure vegetarian snacks & free shrine langar along the holy trail (Himkoti & Bhawan); dinner upon descent.
• 🏨 **Stay:** Overnight rest & recovery at Niharika Complex (Yatri Niwas, Shakti Bhawan & Ashirwad) (Dharamshala)

#### Day 3: Check-out & Return Journey
*Base: Katra ➔ Delhi | Exertion: Light*
• 08:30 AM – 10:30 AM: Leisure breakfast and hotel check-out at Niharika Complex (Yatri Niwas, Shakti Bhawan & Ashirwad)
• 11:00 AM – 01:00 PM: Last-minute Katra bazaar shopping (dry fruits, Mata prasad, devotional mementos)
• 01:30 PM – Onward: Transfer to Katra Bus Stand and return journey to Delhi by Bus
• 🍽️ **Meals:** Morning breakfast in Katra; transit lunch / refreshments for departure journey.
• 🚆 **Stay:** Return transit journey to Delhi

### 🚆 Transport Recommendation (Delhi ➔ Katra)
• **Recommended Service:** FlixBus AC Seater / Sleeper (BharatBenz)
• **Operator:** FlixBus | Mode: Bus
• **Timings:** Departure ~18:25 ➔ Arrival ~06:43 (12h 18m)
• **Indicative Fare:** ₹499 per person one-way (~₹998 round-trip)
• **Total Group Transport Cost:** ₹1,996 (Round-trip for 2 pilgrims)
• **Local Transfers:** Katra Railway Station / Bus Stand to hotel via local auto (₹100–150 per vehicle)
• **Travel Tip:** Pre-booking is recommended during festive peaks (Navratri / summer).

### 🏨 Accommodation Arrangements
• **Recommended Property:** Niharika Complex (Yatri Niwas, Shakti Bhawan & Ashirwad)
• **Category:** Dharamshala | **Allocation:** 1 room for 2 nights (2 guests)
• **Tariff:** ₹150 per room/night | **Total Stay Cost:** ₹300 for 2 nights
• **Address / Landmark:** Shakti Bhawan, Niharika Complex, Near Main Bus Stand, Katra, Reasi District, Jammu and Kashmir - 182301
• **Curated Category Alternatives in Katra:**
  - *Pilgrim / Subsidized:* SMVDSB Yatri Niwas (Niharika, Shakti Bhawan) at ₹150–500/night
  - *Standard Hotel:* Registered Private AC Hotel (near Bus Stand) at ₹1,000–1,800/night
  - *Premium Comfort:* 3-Star / 4-Star Resort (with in-house dining) at ₹2,500–4,500/night

### 💰 Budget Breakdown & Cost Estimate (2 Pilgrims · 3 Days)
• 🚆 **Intercity Travel (Bus Round-trip):** ₹1,996 (~₹998/person)
• 🏨 **Accommodation (1 rooms × 2 nights):** ₹300
• 🍽️ **Meals & Refreshments (₹350/person/day):** ₹2,100
• 🛺 **Local Katra Transfers:** ₹500
• 🎫 **Yatra Registration (RFID Parchi):** ₹0 (Free mandatory pilgrimage pass)
• 🛡️ **Contingency / Emergency Buffer:** ₹500
• 📊 **Estimated Total Group Cost:** ₹5,396
• 👤 **Estimated Cost Per Person:** ₹2,698

*Note: Fares and hotel tariffs reflect published baseline rates and standard seasonal estimates. Exact rates are confirmed at booking.*

### ⚙️ Customization & Next Steps

• *“Switch hotel to standard private hotel”* or *“Show premium resorts”*

• *“Add Baba Dhansar or Patnitop”* or *“Keep only Katra & Bhawan”*
• *“Adjust trip duration to 3 days”* or *“Update budget”*
• *“Confirm booking”* or *“Book Yatra Parchi”* to proceed with registration and reservations.

suggested_places.timings: 5 AM-12 PM & 4 PM-9 PM (ropeway 8 AM-5 PM)
suggested_places.description: A shrine many pilgrims visit right after Vaishno Devi darshan itself — local tradition holds the pilgrimage is considered incomplete without it.
suggested_places.historical_background: According to the legend, Bhairavnath was a powerful tantric sage who pursued the goddess Vaishnavi, who fled into the Trikuta hills and took the form of Mahakali to behead him at the cave entrance. Realizing her true divine nature in his dying moments, he begged forgiveness — and she granted it, along with a boon: no pilgrimage to Vaishno Devi would be complete without visiting his shrine too, which is why this stop remains a core part of the yatra to this day.
suggested_places.religious_information: Shrine dedicated to Tantric sage Bhairavnath; local tradition holds the Vaishno Devi pilgrimage is complete only after visiting this shrine.
suggested_places.best_time_to_visit: Year-round; early morning or right after Bhawan Darshan
suggested_places.accessibility: Steep ~1.5–2 km trek uphill from Bhawan or via passenger ropeway (₹100 one-way, ~5-minute ride).
suggested_places.seasonal_restrictions: Exposed high-altitude point (~6,600 ft) with sub-zero night chills in winter; heavy woollens and windproof jackets required.

suggested_places.name: Ardhkuwari Cave
suggested_places.distance: Roughly halfway up the 13 km trek from Katra
suggested_places.entry_fee: Free (₹350 one-way for the battery car)
suggested_places.description: A cave shrine associated with the goddess's own legend, and a natural resting point partway through the climb.
suggested_places.historical_background: Known as Garbh Joon (womb cave), this is where the goddess is said to have meditated undisturbed for nine months while fleeing Bhairavnath — mirroring a child's time in the womb. Many pilgrims crawl through the narrow original cave passage as an act of symbolic spiritual rebirth, alongside the wider passage now available for those who prefer it.
suggested_places.darshan_timings: Open 24/7 (Garbh Joon cave queue managed by computerized slip/waiting numbers)
suggested_places.religious_information: Sacred cave where Mata Vaishnavi meditated for nine months (Garbh Joon) before proceeding to Bhawan.
suggested_places.accessibility: Midway milestone (~6 km from Katra on traditional route); battery car and palki options available.
suggested_places.seasonal_restrictions: Runs colder than Katra town; keep a light jacket accessible while waiting for Garbh Joon entry.

itinerary.title: Dedicated Holy Yatra & Darshan Trek

activities: 05:30 AM – 06:30 AM: Early morning trek departure from Katra base via Ban Ganga / Tarakote Marg (13 km ascent)

04:30 PM – 08:30 PM: Scenic descent back to Katra base town and overnight muscle recovery

itinerary.practicality_note: Vaishno Devi trek is a physically demanding 13 km ascent + descent requiring a full dedicated day with zero conflicting travel or distant excursions.
